description_en: Queries the MCP Server connectivity and tool list results by the Session ID returned when the detection was started
description_zh: 根据启动检测时返回的 Session ID 查询 MCP Server 连通性和工具列表结果
name: GetListMcpServerToolsResult

parameters.help_en: The DMS unit identifier. This value is typically the same as the DMSUnit used in the request that started the tool detection
parameters.help_zh: DMS 单元标识。通常与启动工具检测请求使用的 DMSUnit 保持一致
parameters.name: dms_unit

parameters.help_en: The temporary session ID returned by StartListMcpServerTools. This ID is used to locate the connectivity detection task
parameters.help_zh: StartListMcpServerTools 返回的临时会话 ID，用于定位本次连通性检测
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The MCP Server ID used when the detection was started. This value must match the detection record associated with the SessionId
parameters.help_zh: 启动检测时使用的 MCP Server ID；必须与 SessionId 对应的检测记录一致
parameters.name: mcp_server_uuid

Data.description_en: The MCP Server connectivity detection result. The business status is distinguished by the State field
Data.description_zh: MCP Server 连通性检测结果。业务状态通过 State 区分

Accessible.description_en: Indicates whether the MCP Server is accessible. The value is true only when State is success
Accessible.description_zh: MCP Server 是否可访问。仅当 State 为 success 时取值为 true

State.description_en:
The detection status. Valid values:
pending: The detection is in progress.
success: The detection succeeded.
failed: The detection failed or timed out.

The top-level Success field can be true in all three business states
State.description_zh: 检测状态。取值：pending 表示检测中；success 表示检测成功；failed 表示检测失败或超时。三种业务状态下顶层 Success 均可为 true

Tools.description_en: The list of detected MCP tools. A non-empty list is returned only when State is success
Tools.description_zh: 检测到的 MCP 工具列表。仅当 State 为 success 时返回非空列表

Description.description_en: The description of the MCP tool functionality
Description.example: query user information by user ID

InputSchema.description_en: The JSON Schema string of the tool input parameters
InputSchema.description_zh: 工具输入参数的 JSON Schema 字符串

ErrorCode.description_en: The return code. The value success is returned if the request succeeds. An error code is returned if the request fails
ErrorCode.description_zh: 返回码。请求成功时为 success；请求失败时为对应的错误码

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when a system-level request failure occurs
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 系统级请求失败时返回的错误信息
ErrorMessage.example: no mcp connect test record for session

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate this API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次调用

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values: true and false
Success.description_zh: 请求处理是否成功。取值为 true 表示成功，取值为 false 表示失败
